subject: Create scenario builder (src/engine/scenario.ts) + tests
description:
Create `src/engine/scenario.ts` with:
- `createScenarioFromHour(hour, isDay?)` — creates Scenario from an hour value, auto-detects isDay (6-20 = day)
- `createScenarioFromNow()` — creates Scenario from current time
- `describeScenario(scenario)` — generates human-readable description string
- `getTimeOfDayDescription(hour)` — private helper mapping hour ranges to descriptions (dawn, morning, midday, afternoon, evening, dusk, night)
- `getWeatherDescription(weatherCode?)` — private helper mapping WMO weather codes to descriptions

Also create `tests/engine/scenario.test.ts` with tests from the plan:
- createScenarioFromHour: correct hour, auto-detects day/night
- describeScenario: morning description, night description

Depends on: types.ts (Task #2)
